channel.title: The Alabama Baptist - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Alabama Baptist (thealabamabaptist.org)

item.title: Ambush kills pastor, two family members; grandchild left to die
item.description: A pastor and two family members were slain and his infant grandchild sustained a serious machete wound when extremists ambushed the family Jan. 16.

item.title: Latest news: Tragedy and ministry amid mass shooting in Canada; remembering SBC’s ‘open mic legend’; handling small group leadership issues
item.description: Check out these recent headlines, reported by The Baptist Paper.

item.title: Congressional hearing highlights state’s reading success
item.description: Alabama’s efforts to improve literacy were on full display on Capitol Hill on Feb. 10 as Bonnie Short of the Alabama Reading Initiative detailed to House appropriators how the state’s efforts have helped students become better readers.

item.title: Panola’s Galilee Baptist, other rural churches burned in 2006 mark 20 years of God’s blessings
item.description: More than 100 people from Alabama and Mississippi gathered at Galilee Missionary Baptist Church in Panola the evening of Feb. 7 to mark the 20th anniversary of what Pastor Bob Little calls “a blessing in the blaze.”

item.title: Pastor dragged to jail after woman puts faith in Jesus
item.description: Relatives of a recent convert to Christianity dragged a pastor to jail and vowed he will remain there until the woman returns to her family, sources say.

item.title: Alabama bill spotlights stronger camp regulations after Camp Mystic tragedy
item.description: Calling it "100% preventable," the parents of 8-year-old Sarah Marsh — who died tragically when floodwaters swept through cabins at Camp Mystic in Texas last summer — are urging stronger camp safety laws.

item.title: Multigenerational mission work and building something ‘beautiful’
item.description: Second Baptist Church in Springfield, Missouri, has made “multigenerational” an emphasis in their pursuit of mission work, and the result has been a success.

item.title: Custody of 13-year-old Christian girl given to captor
item.description: A Pakistani court granted custody of a kidnapped 13-year-old Christian girl to her adult male captor, disregarding another court's ruling that their supposed "marriage" was not legal, an attorney stated.

item.title: First person: How would I respond if what I did to another was done to me?
item.description: We are moving quickly toward Easter — it’s April 5 this year. As we prepare our hearts to observe Resurrection Sunday and the days of Holy Week leading up to Easter, would you be open to a bit of Lenten-type fasting this year?

item.title: Pastor Connections: Marriage and ministry; AI and Billy Graham; make your sermons memorable
item.description: A few tips and more for pastors from pastors and church leaders.
